audit_events_versions.name: audit_events_versions
audit_events_versions.value: ("hims"."audit_events"."before_version" IS NULL OR "hims"."audit_events"."before_version" > 0) AND ("hims"."audit_events"."after_version" IS NULL OR "hims"."audit_events"."after_version" > 0)

patient_age_identity.name: patient_age_identity
patient_age_identity.value: ("hims"."patients"."date_of_birth" is not null) <> ("hims"."patients"."age_years_at_registration" is not null)

room_stay_cursor_boundary.name: room_stay_cursor_boundary
room_stay_cursor_boundary.value: "hims"."room_stays"."last_reconciled_at" is null or ("hims"."room_stays"."last_reconciled_at" >= "hims"."room_stays"."started_at" and ("hims"."room_stays"."ended_at" is null or "hims"."room_stays"."last_reconciled_at" <= "hims"."room_stays"."ended_at"))
